result.plainSummary: Readers can now find dated correction documents directly from the original spec without opening the app.
result.summary: Independent documentation-amendment review grounded in the refreshed related pack. Verified all three index links, each original-spec backlink and each change-record link resolve in the repository. Both historical changes are closed and belong to this workstream, with four and eight attachments respectively; the current change is open and its document does not assert passing checks. Later-written historical explanations carry their actual added date. The recorded document amendment cites decision 33004752-6f05-4938-bcc6-40f4d6cd8d01 and preserves acceptance. The issue-intake/sl-learn guidance scopes this discoverability rule to corrections of existing specs, retains original records, requires relative-link checks and uses existing amendment operations without creating a new approval gate or task history. No blocking spec gaps found.
residualRisks: The current responsive-browsing correction remains open; this documentation approval does not establish its implementation, code review or verification outcome.
Future correction documents should link to recorded evidence and preserve added-date labeling rather than retroactively imply contemporaneous documentation.
The related tool still supplies only generic worktree caution text, not actual sibling-path scan evidence.
